summary: Turn rough requests into evidence-backed executable work
description: Add bounded task exploration before execution: inspect existing code, tasks, decisions and relevant vision; reproduce reported defects or create scoped research, then reuse/update/materialize the smallest independently deliverable tasks. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: Preserve every original requested outcome and source; detect matching existing work and superseded decisions. Repeated intake does not duplicate tasks or lose feedback.

Substantial tasks have observable before/after behavior, relevant states/edges, non-goals, enforceable dependencies, delegated choices and outcome-appropriate proof. Unknown bug root cause cannot become fixed; research completion remains distinct from implementation.

Use actual bounded model exploration/assessment through existing adapters; deterministic tests prove transport, authority and persistence rather than pretending keywords/schema prove semantic quality. Legacy tiny tasks stay lightweight.

Planning-only requests stop before execution; advice is not execution authority. Persist questions needing the user while continuing only independent authorized research/work; no automatic vision/decision rewriting.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.
verification: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with 'pytest>=8,<9' --with 'jsonschema>=4.23' python -m pytest tests/test_autonomy_intake.py tests/test_task_design_readiness.py tests/test_architecture.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
